question: Within the 2015 dataset for accidents that occurred from January through August and involved more than one distinct person, what percentage of these accidents had more than one individual with a severe injury (injury severity = 4)
sql:
WITH accident_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number, 
    consecutive_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT person_number) as person_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN injury_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as severe_injury_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2015`
  WHERE month_of_crash BETWEEN 1 AND 8
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT person_number) > 1
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_accidents,
  SUM(CASE WHEN severe_injury_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as accidents_with_more_than_one_severe,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN severe_injury_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0,
    COUNT(*)
  ) as percentage
FROM accident_stats
